name: rushdb
description: RushDB for agents: search, query and analyze your data with RushDB MCP tools and skills, with optional automatic context across sessions.

api_key.title: RushDB API key
api_key.description: Project API key from the RushDB dashboard. Only the automatic-context hooks use it; the MCP tools sign in with OAuth.

api_url.title: RushDB API URL
api_url.description: Leave the default for RushDB Cloud; set your own URL for a self-hosted RushDB.

auto_context.title: Automatic context
auto_context.description: off: hooks do nothing. recall: recall earlier context at session start. recall+persist: also store finished turns in RushDB.

context_scope.title: Context scope
context_scope.description: Optional name that replaces the project key, to share context across folders or keep it apart. Empty: one scope per git remote or folder.
